mainEntity.name: Can a bonus room addition be designed to serve as an in-law suite or ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, a bonus room can be planned to function interchangeably as an accessory dwelling unit or mother-in-law suite, provided specific structural features are included. To qualify as a practical multigenerational space, the plan should incorporate a full bathroom, dedicated egress, a closet, and adequate electrical service for kitchen appliances or a wet bar. Bay City Remodeling & Bathrooms regularly coordinates multi-use additions, handling the necessary framing, drywall, and structural layout so the room can evolve from a family recreation area into private independent living quarters whenever necessary.
